Keep one indigo cloth satchel, white flower flap, small brass clasp and red chili knot. No clothes or footwear on the toad, no new human ears or changed creature design.
LOW-SPECKLE REQUIREMENT: large coherent painted color shapes and mild modeling. Leaves one base green plus at most one broad shadow plane. Group grass, bamboo foliage and distant trees into clear clumps. Earth / stone surfaces have intact continuous base colors and only a few broad soft tonal shifts, retaining necessary joints and contact shadows. No dense soil dots, camouflage-like flecks, excessive tiny highlights or gritty paper overlay. Preserve character's key spots, not all-over tiny peppering. Not blurry, bleached, washed-out, flat vector or glossy 3D. Environment remains larger than the characters, with calm breathing room, not a close-up portrait.
Keep this an unhurried, warmly observed local-life story with restrained humor. Correct readable limbs and object contact. Only the story-implied new characters / props below.

entries.title: 竹林边，抓天牛
entries.story: 天牛刚从树皮上探出头，就被它轻轻拢在爪爪里。两根长须晃啊晃，它也跟着歪脑壳：你倒是莫慌嘛。
entries.scene:
NEW STORY: Replace playing with the bamboo dragonfly toy with catching a real longhorn beetle (天牛) at the edge of the bamboo grove. Keep the quiet Daoming bamboo-country courtyard, bamboo shade, plain gray-tiled farmhouse and distant fields in the reference's style. The toad crouches beside a low rough tree trunk among the bamboo; the beetle has just been caught from that trunk. Clearly show one small black longhorn BEETLE gently enclosed between the rounded digits of one raised forepaw at chest height; its whole hard elongated oval wingcase is visible, with a restrained few pale cream spots, SIX slender legs and TWO unmistakably long curved segmented black-and-cream antennae, longer than its body. The antennae have clear space, are not confused with extra legs, and the beetle is proportionately tiny compared to the toad's head, not a monster. Catch is gentle and loose, no crushing, injury, gore, torn wings or pinching antennae. The other forepaw supports the toad naturally on the ground. Toad looks closely at its catch with mild curiosity and a slightly tilted head, relaxed closed mouth: no licking, extended tongue or eating. Satchel rests nearby on dry ground.
REMOVE the toy bamboo rotor and spindle completely; no dragonfly toy, live dragonfly, butterfly, net, specimen jar, extra insects or human figures. Tree bark uses a few broad longitudinal shapes rather than noisy dots. Keep the little caught beetle readable against the cream chest / open air, not hidden by the hand. Natural peaceful afternoon light and clean ground shapes.

entries.title: 采个耳，安逸得很
entries.story: 师傅在耳边轻轻忙活，它把爪爪放稳，连眼皮都懒得抬。旁边的茶慢慢凉了，它还想再坐一哈。
entries.scene:
NEW STORY: Replace fanning with the Sichuan courtyard-teahouse ear-cleaning service (采耳), performed on our fictional toad. Keep the shaded Chengdu outdoor tea courtyard, cream fabric umbrella, bamboo chairs / table, blue-and-white lidded teacup and indigo flower bag. The toad is relaxed and reclining naturally in a low bamboo armchair, with both rounded forepaws resting still on its cream belly / chair arm and eyes gently half closed. REMOVE the palm fan completely.
Add ONE ordinary adult male ear-cleaning practitioner beside / slightly behind the chair, close enough to work without stretched limbs, shown from head to lower body with anatomically coherent arms and hands. Match the plain, gentle hand-painted human treatment of image 2, without copying its woman. He wears a simple muted gray-blue button shirt with rolled sleeves, dark loose trousers and ordinary shoes, short slightly graying hair, no costume, turban, sash, medical scrubs or dramatic expression. His posture is calm and attentive. One hand holds a slim traditional metal-handled ear-cleaning implement with a tiny soft pale tuft tip, gently at the toad's ear-side just behind the eye; the other hand lightly steadies the side of the head or holds a small folded clean cloth nearby, without covering the eye or face. A small simple opened cloth tool roll with only two or three fine implements sits neatly nearby as a secondary cue.
Fictional gentle stylized scene, NOT a procedure diagram. The ear-side touch is light and external; no deep insertion, puncture, pain, wax closeup, syringe, blood, dissection or invasive action. Crucially keep the toad's existing head silhouette and orange bean gland; DO NOT grow a human ear, giant ear flap, hole or monstrous new anatomy. The human's tool points toward the ear-side rather than into an eye or the top of the head. Keep both faces readable and the interaction unmistakable. Human and chair contact make physical sense, preserve quiet space in the tea courtyard and the original character-to-world scale.

entries.title: 这家在摆坝坝宴
entries.story: 顺着菜香拐过田埂，院坝里已经摆开了几桌。端菜的来来回回，它在路边停了脚：今天这儿闹热哦。
entries.scene:
NEW STORY: Replace ducks crossing the path with the toad coming across an outdoor village courtyard banquet (四川坝坝宴) beside the fields. Retain the reference's flat Chengdu-plain rice fields, narrow earth path and water channel, bamboo/tree linpan clusters, ordinary white-walled gray-tiled farmhouse and soft sunny countryside. Reframe as a wide natural establishing postcard: the paddy path leads to the edge of a lived-in FARMHOUSE OPEN COURTYARD, not a city restaurant. The toad stays in the near foreground on the path OUTSIDE the gathering, pausing with its indigo flower satchel by its side and gazing into the courtyard in three-quarter profile. It is an observer passing by, not seated at a table, serving, eating or hosting. Keep its face / amber eyes and cream belly readable. REMOVE all ducks.
In the middle ground, show THREE plain round wooden banquet tables with simple mismatched low stools and shared serving plates / rice bowls / chopsticks; a small modest gathering of ordinary adult and older villagers seated in natural conversational poses, plus ONE adult carrying a platter from the side cooking area toward a table. Keep the number of clearly rendered people modest (about eight altogether) and their silhouettes separated, hands and faces coherent. At the side, a compact country cooking setup with a large pot and a short stack of bamboo steamers, a little rising steam. Visible communal tables, dishes and moving server must immediately read as a rural outdoor banquet rather than another tea garden. Simple gray-blue / earth-tone everyday shirts, dark trousers, naturally gray hair on some older villagers; use image 2 only for the human drawing style.
No wedding couple, celebratory banner, readable text, stage, red carpet, huge red lanterns, uniform tablecloths, luxury restaurant decoration or invented named occasion. Lively but gentle and spacious, not a dense chaotic festival crowd. The field edge / irrigation ditch remains clearly separate from the dry courtyard, not tables sitting in flooded rice. Rice paddies extend to a low flat horizon; no mountainous terraces. Dishes should be a few legible clean painted food shapes, not photographic piles of tiny ingredients. No added bowls or fan/hat in the toad's paws.
